day.reading: six of twelve became mutators through loss of DNA repair (four mismatch, two oxidative)

critic.reading: the six and 96.5% match Tenaillon 2016; the 4+2 split is not in the quoted passage; six (50,000, Tenaillon) and seven (60,000, Wielgoss 2013 / Consuegra 2021) are two classifications at two endpoints, not one count

notes: The six populations and the 96.5% share match Tenaillon 2016 verbatim, and Day's Z23020792 six are the same six. Day's Z23003785 and Z23105291 count seven at 60,000 generations; the seventh is Ara+1, an IS-element mutator of about 5x, so the six-versus-seven difference is a later endpoint and a different classifier (Wielgoss 2013 / Consuegra 2021), not a recount of the same set. Clopper-Pearson 95% for 6/12 is 0.2109-0.7891 (Day: about 21-79%). Day's 4 mutS/mutL + 2 mutT split sums to the six but is held only as Day's wording: the Tenaillon passage names no gene and the cited sources are not retrieved, so the gene route of each of the six is not in held text (lookup limit, not a contradiction).
